question.text: A gas ( Molar mass <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>=</mo><mn>280</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi>mol</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>) was burnt in excess <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> in a constant volume calorimeter and during combustion the temperature of calorimeter increased from <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>298</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math> to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>298</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>45</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math>. If the heat capacity of calorimeter is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kJ</mi><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> and enthalpy of combustion of gas is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>9</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kJ</mi><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi>mol</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> then amount of gas burnt is____<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math>.

solution.text:
Let x g is burnt

Moles=x280 heat released by x280 mole=2.5×0.45 kJ heat released by 1 mole =2.5×0.45×280xkJ

ΔH=ΔU+ΔngRT

ΔH≃ΔU

9=2.5×280×0.45x

x=35 g
